Baylin Brooks put up 78 yards on eight catches. Eastern Michigan lost 35-7 to Central Michigan on Nov. 4. Brogan McCaughey passed for 59 yards on 12-of-17 attempts (70.6%) with no touchdowns and one interception. Blue had 42 rushing yards on eight carries, adding two receptions for 14 yards.
